item.title: Federal judge blocks Trump DOJ threats against election workers ahead of 2026 midterms
item.description: A federal judge blocked the Trump administration from threatening election workers with prosecution over ballots tied to suspected noncitizens.

item.title: Blaine Holt to Newsmax: Iran Could Surrender Soon
item.description: Retired Air Force Brig. Gen. Blaine Holt told Newsmax on Friday he believes Iran's government could soon surrender to the United States.

item.title: Rep. Boebert to Newsmax: People Don't Want to Go Back to Woke 1.0
